subject: 平遥文庙 · 大成殿正面
author: Gisling
source_note: Gisling于2008年实拍；按五间六柱、中央门与四窗、石栏及侧阶绘制。
prompt: One fine-line heritage illustration for 访古, matching image 1 STYLE MASTER: delicate sparse slightly organic black contours and huge white planes, no shading. Image 2 is the actual photographed monument GEOMETRY, not style. Preserve roof type, structural bay count, openings, silhouette and platform. BLACK thin lines on PURE WHITE. No filled openings, gray, hatching, texture, color, labels or frame. Remove trees, people, umbrellas, signs, banners, offerings and plaque lettering. Landscape 1536x1024, complete selected architecture centered within generous 12% white side margins. Roof and walls remain mostly WHITE with only 3 or 4 suggestion strokes, not dense tile or brick patterns. Draw the Dacheng Hall of Pingyao Confucian Temple: one low broad SINGLE-EAVED hip-and-gable roof, FIVE front bays divided by SIX structural columns, central doorway and four flanking rectangular lattice window bays, prominent triangular long diagonal bracket arms under the eaves as photographed. Keep the stone terrace with its rectangular carved-panel balustrade in front and its two SIDE stairs; do not replace the terrace with an invented central stair. Select just a few relief-outline motifs in the stone panels; sparse window grid. Reduce oblique perspective to nearly frontal, roof tips uncut. Omit neighboring buildings.

site_recommendation.name: 平遥文庙
site_recommendation.lede: 斜拱从柱头向两侧伸展，将五间大殿的深檐托起。平遥文庙大成殿的金代纪年，藏在梁架题记之中。
facts: 大成殿以金大定三年（1163）的重建题记断代，文庙其余建筑另有营建分期。
面阔五间，单檐歇山顶，柱头铺作与斜拱层叠出挑。
图版保留五间六柱与殿前石栏、侧阶；不把院内后世建筑一并归为金构。
